brief.summary: Equities are lower and the Nasdaq is mired in a sharp tech-led October selloff; S&P futures are down modestly. Credit spreads are widening, with AI and high-yield credit repricing, while long-end Treasury yields have fallen on a flight to quality despite this morning’s bounce. Oil is rising on supply and geopolitical risk, with Brent near $115 and WTI above $100; the dollar and gold were not clearly discussed. The Fed is expected to hold next week, though its hawkish bias leaves a later hike in play. The dominant narrative is AI capex versus the cost and availability of financing, feeding a risk-off tone.
